### Cultivar (G4; fandom name)

**Who she is.** A recurring adult Earth-pony mare in *Friendship Is Magic*. Look for her very pale yellow-green coat, light-blue/cyan mane, turquoise eyes, and three-flower cutie mark (one blue bloom, two smaller red-pink flowers). The fan-maintained [Earth-pony catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies) calls her “Cultivar”; I could not verify an official spoken or merchandise name, who coined it, or when. The botanical word fits the flowers, but that naming explanation is unconfirmed.

**Where to spot her.** *Leap of Faith* (S4E20), bandaged; later *Equestria Games*, *The Perfect Pear*, *The Point of No Return*, *She Talks to Angel*, and *A Horse Shoe-In*. In *She Talks to Angel*, Angel Bunny, speaking through Fluttershy's body, directs a tongue twister at her; the [transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/She_Talks_to_Angel) credits the speech to **Angel**, not Cultivar. A recolored unicorn look appears in some background scenes, with no confirmed in-story transformation.

**Speaking and fan lore.** No verified spoken dialogue or voice actress for Cultivar. She is **not Jinx**, the pony who challenges Applejack about the Flim Flam tonic in the [*Leap of Faith* transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Leap_of_Faith). A possible family relationship with Nurse Snowheart is **fan headcanon**, not established TV continuity.
